name: has_cache
title: Test whether a result is cached

origin.description: Ask whether a memoised function already stored a call.
origin.details: The returned function takes the same arguments as f.
origin.value: True when that call is stored.
origin.example:
m <- memoise(function(x) x)
before <- has_cache(m)(1)
invisible(m(1))
after <- has_cache(m)(1)
cat(paste(as.integer(before), as.integer(after)), "\n", sep = "")

translation.description: Ask whether a memoised function already stored a call.
translation.details: The returned function takes the same arguments as f.
translation.value: True when that call is stored.
translation.example:
from memoise import *
m = memoise(lambda x: x)
before = has_cache(m)(1)
m(1)
after = has_cache(m)(1)
print(int(before), int(after))
